raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 rows are tagged source_tz='UTC', but their txn_ts values are stored in UTC, while all other batches are America/Chicago local time. The pipeline never converts them, so about 99 evening-Chicago transactions land on 2026-01-19 at 00:00-06:00 UTC. Converting UTC rows to America/Chicago in silver_transactions should move them to the correct business date and restore the local-time distribution.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH s AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts_local FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts_local AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts_local AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM s;"}}
